headline: Anthropic projects second consecutive profitable quarter amid geopolitical scrutiny
body: Anthropic reported to investors that it will achieve profitability for a second consecutive quarter, signaling the company has moved beyond the capital-intensive scaling phase that defined most AI startups. This milestone matters for healthcare AI because vendor financial stability directly impacts clinical deployment continuity, long-term API reliability, and R&D investment in domain-specific models for medical applications. A profitable AI vendor can commit to the multi-year integrations that healthcare systems require, particularly for EHR-embedded tools and value-based care workflows. However, Anthropic simultaneously faces mounting geopolitical pressure over its public positions on AI governance, which could affect international healthcare deployments and regulatory positioning. Healthcare organizations evaluating Anthropic's Claude for clinical use should monitor both the company's financial trajectory and its ability to navigate compliance requirements across different regulatory jurisdictions.
